apb-dual-icm42605.evidence_scope: Dual ICM42605 IDs read from the MRM2-10 ArduPilot FC on 2026-11-20. Candidate rotations copied from the retained 4.8-associated board definition; the original 4.8 build inputs are not proven complete. A separate Betaflight reference unit has the same chip population but does not validate ArduPilot axes.
apb-dual-icm42605.candidate_source: Retained 2026-10-26 MRM2-10 4.8-associated installed-hwdef.dat SHA256 548e31466e2209b9476959f93e9e0102090115104a348c517add0754389f9fbc. The 4.7.2 and 4.8.0-dev ICM42605 raw FIFO-to-rotation path has the same axis operations; this does not prove the exact installed binary was compiled from this file.
apb-dual-icm42605.note: Experimental Copter candidate at the revision in upstream.lock.json under the same hardware-unvalidated prerelease policy as other targets. Do not infer flight readiness from matching MCU, a successful probe, a shared board ID, a 4.8.0-dev flight, or Betaflight qualification.
